examples.cn: 每年美国人都消耗掉世界能源的很大比例

examples.cn: 我敢肯定,世界上中国人吃掉的大米最多。

examples.cn: 她让他每两周写一篇有关欧洲情况的文章。

examples.cn: 我觉得难以用言语表达我的感情。

examples.en: Word will suffice to convey his grief.

definitions.meaning: 发展；发育；开发；冲洗(照片)

examples.cn: 现代音乐最初是在意大利发展起来的。

examples.en: China can't develop in isolation from the rest of the world.
examples.cn: 中国的发展离不开世界。

examples.cn: 植物由种子发育而成,而许多动物由卵子发育而来。

definitions.meaning: 致力于；奉献给；把...专用于

examples.cn: 你必须专心于工作。

examples.cn: 毕业以后,他继续潜心于这项研究。

examples.cn: 这些东西的区别只是大小不同而实质一样。

examples.en: History discarded him.

examples.cn: 所陈列的威士忌酒都是假的。

examples.cn: 他经过多年的研究，逐渐总结出了新的理论。

examples.cn: 女人一成不变，男人一定会变。

examples.en: It would naturally injure him in her estimation.
examples.cn: 那自然也会损害到她对他的评价。

examples.en: He insisted that he had done right.
examples.cn: 他坚决认为自己做对了。

examples.en: They insist that I stay there for supper.
examples.cn: 他们坚决要求让我留下吃晚饭。

examples.en: Since you insist, I must amend the letter of credit.
examples.cn: 既然你坚持，我就只好修改信用证。

definitions.meaning: 鼓舞；激发；产生；赋予...灵感

examples.en: We're trying to inspire him with confidence.
examples.cn: 我们在努力鼓舞他的自信心。

examples.en: The sight inspired him with nostalgia.
examples.cn: 这景象激起了他的怀旧之情。

examples.en: The failure inspired him to greater efforts.
examples.cn: 失败激发他作更大的努力。

examples.en: She installed her air-conditioner without help by herself.
examples.cn: 她自己安装了空调。

examples.en: The workers are installing a heating system.
examples.cn: 工人们正在安装供暖系统。

examples.en: It is necessary that you install a burglar alarm.
examples.cn: 你有必要装防盗警报器。

examples.en: I haven't been to the exhibition, neither do I intend to go.
examples.cn: 我还没有看展览会,我也不想去。

examples.en: My husband trusts me and I don't intend to break that trust
examples.cn: 我的丈夫信任我,所以我不想失去这种信任

examples.en: I've chosen the main actors and we intend to put it on next January.
examples.cn: 我已经选好了主要演员,打算明年一月上演这出戏。

definitions.meaning: 包含；使忙于；牵涉；使卷入；使陷入

examples.en: A letter of credit will involve unnecessary extra charges.
examples.cn: 信用证包含有不必要的额外开支。

examples.en: The Genius is a lovable physicist who is deeply involved in defining the workings of the universe.
examples.cn: 老天才是一位可爱的学者，他整天忙于解释天地间的各种现象。.

examples.en: Don't involve other people in your trouble.
examples.cn: 别把别人牵涉进你的麻烦中去。

examples.en: We must isolate the handful of enemies to the maximum.
examples.cn: 我们要最大限度地孤立一小撮敌人。

examples.en: We should never isolate ourselves from the masses.
examples.cn: 我们永远不能脱离群众。

examples.en: The patient should isolate from his child.
examples.cn: 这个病人必须立刻和他的孩子隔离。

definitions.meaning: 替 ... 辩护；证明 ... 正当；调整版面

examples.en: He had to justify himself for his conduct.
examples.cn: 他不得不为自己的行为辩白。

examples.en: Don't try to justify your mistakes.
examples.cn: 不要为自己的缺点辩护。

examples.en: Nothing can justify your cheating on an exam.
examples.cn: 任何事情都不能成为你考试作弊的理由。

examples.en: Her decision seems to show a lack of political judgement.
examples.cn: 她的决定似乎显示出缺乏政治判断力。

examples.en: Lack of sun retards plant growth.
examples.cn: 光照不足则植物生长缓慢。

examples.en: In a cold winter, many wild animals can die from lack of food.
examples.cn: 在严寒的冬天,很多野生动物可能因缺乏食物而死去。

definitions.meaning: 发起；推出（新产品）；发射；使(船)下水

examples.en: We were going to launch a counterattack.
examples.cn: 我们准备发起反攻。

examples.en: The company researched the market demand and decided to launch their new product.
examples.cn: 这家公司调查了市场需求，决定推出新产品。

examples.en: The people all over the country exulted in the success in launching a new satellite.
examples.cn: 全国人民为成功地发射了一颗新的人造卫星而欢欣鼓舞。

definitions.meaning: 维持；维修；保养；坚持；断言

examples.en: It is absolutely vital that food supplies should be maintained.
examples.cn: 维持食物的供给是绝对必要的。

examples.en: They also help us to maintain the machinery.
examples.cn: 他们还帮助我们维修机器。

examples.en: They tell the peasants in detail how to maintain the pumps.
examples.cn: 他们详细地教给农民怎样保养抽水机。

definitions.meaning: 管理；经营；做成；设法对付；提供；有空

examples.en: He managed the company when his father was away.
examples.cn: 他父亲离开的时候,由他管理公司。

examples.en: The success of the restaurant lies in that it is well managed.
examples.cn: 这个餐厅的成功在于它的完善经营。

examples.en: I shall be able to manage it without help.
examples.cn: 我一个人能行。

examples.en: Governments consider it prudent to minimize the risk.
examples.cn: 各国政府均认为把这种危害降低到最小程度的做法是明智的。

examples.en: The polar explorers took every precaution to minimize the dangers of their trip.
examples.cn: 极地探险者十分小心谨慎，以便使旅途的危险性减少到最小。

examples.en: A sound approach to the problem is to minimize the number of parts.
examples.cn: 正确解决这一问题的方法是把零件的数目减至最少。

definitions.meaning: 激发(兴趣或欲望)；给与动机

examples.en: He is just sitting there doing nothing. He needs to be motivated.
examples.cn: 他坐在那儿什么也不干,他需要一点动力去激发他。

examples.en: The crime appears to have been motivated by hatred.
examples.cn: 犯罪似乎都来自于仇恨。

examples.en: A good teacher is one who can motivate his students.
examples.cn: 好老师是能激励学生的老师。

definitions.meaning: 谈判达成；成功越过；议价出售

examples.en: We've decided to negotiate with the employers about our wage claim.
examples.cn: 我们决定就工资问题与雇主谈判。

examples.en: We are happy to negotiate with you in that way.
examples.cn: 我们很高兴用这种方式来和贵方协商交易。

examples.en: Trade union leaders went back to negotiate with the government.
examples.cn: 工会领导回去和政府进行交涉。

examples.en: We have to observe carefully what's going on there.
examples.cn: 我们必须仔细观察那里的动静。

examples.en: He made a telescope through which he could observe the stars.
examples.cn: 他做了个望远镜,用其观察星座。

examples.en: All citizens should observe traffic rules.
examples.cn: 每位公民都应该遵守交通规则。

examples.en: He failed to obtain a scholarship.
examples.cn: 他没有获得奖学金。

examples.en: At last, their company obtained the mining concession.
examples.cn: 他们的公司最终获得了采矿权。

examples.en: Those who were penitent obtained absolution.
examples.cn: 悔过者获得了赦免。

definitions.meaning: 占用；占领；从事；使忙碌；专心

examples.en: Is that seat occupied?
examples.cn: 那个座位有人吗？

examples.en: Reading occupies most of my free time.
examples.cn: 阅读占去了我大部分的闲暇时间。

examples.en: We occupy the farm and raise a lot of poultry.
examples.cn: 我们拥有这个农场并养着许多家禽。

definitions.meaning: 提供；提出；（卖方）出价；贡献

examples.en: We offer a free backup service to customers.
examples.cn: 对顾客我们提供免费配套服务。

examples.en: Can you offer any evidence in support of what you have said?
examples.cn: 你能提出证据来印证你讲的话吗？

examples.en: We offered 100,000 for the warehouse, but another company outbid us.
examples.cn: 我们出价1000,000英镑购买这个库房,但另一家公司出价高于我们。

examples.en: It's too difficult for him to operate this new sophisticated machine.
examples.cn: 对他来说,操作这台复杂的机器太难了。

examples.en: The lift doesn't operate properly.
examples.cn: 这台电梯运转不正常。

examples.en: They operate three factories and a huge warehouse.
examples.cn: 他们经营三家工厂和一个大仓库。

examples.en: It was courageous of him to oppose his chief.
examples.cn: 他敢反对他的上司，真是勇敢。

examples.en: The rabbles met on the square to oppose their new mayor.
examples.cn: 平民们在广场上集会反对他们的新市长。

examples.en: They opposed the government's new policies.
examples.cn: 他们反对政府的新政策。

examples.en: The meeting was badly organized.
examples.cn: 会议组织得很糟。

examples.en: They planned to organize a scientific expedition.
examples.cn: 他们计划组织一次科学考察。

examples.en: I was asked to organize the trip, but I messed it up.
examples.cn: 大家要我组织这次旅游，可是我把事情搞糟了。

definitions.meaning: 俯瞰；远眺；没注意到；忽视

examples.en: My room overlooked the garden.
examples.cn: 我的房间俯瞰花园。

examples.en: We overlook the church from our house.
examples.cn: 我们可从家中俯瞰教堂。

examples.en: My room overlooks the sea.
examples.cn: 从我的房间可眺望大海。

examples.en: Everyone in the class is expected to participate in the discussion.
examples.cn: 希望全班同学参加讨论。

examples.en: In the ancient Greek Olympics, only men were allowed to participate in it.
examples.cn: 在古希腊奥运会中,只允许男人参加比赛。

examples.en: I don't want to participate in the English party.
examples.cn: 我不想参加英语晚会。

definitions.meaning: 注意到；觉察到；认为；理解

examples.en: I plainly perceive some objections remain.
examples.cn: 我清楚地察觉到还有一些反对意见。

examples.en: We can perceive his sorrow by the looks on his face.
examples.cn: 我们从他的表情中觉察出悲伤。

examples.en: Indeed, this problem is greater than one may perceive.
examples.cn: 确实，这个问题远大于你所能感知到的。

definitions.meaning: 执行；履行；表演；运转；举行

examples.en: Every manager must perform some duties of a ceremonial nature.
examples.cn: 每个管理者必须执行一些礼仪性的任务。

examples.en: Student teams perform a comprehensive analysis and valuation of a business, as outlined in the syllabus.
examples.cn: 如同课程大纲所提及，每一组学生都要对一个企业执行广泛的分析与评价。

examples.en: They always perform their duties faithfully.
examples.cn: 他们总是忠实地履行自己的职责。

examples.en: How can I persuade you of my sincerity?
examples.cn: 我如何能够让你相信我的诚意？

examples.en: We are persuaded of the justice of her case.
examples.cn: 我们确信对她案件的审理是公正的。

examples.en: I am not fully persuaded by the evidence.
examples.cn: 这证据不足以使我充分信服。

examples.en: Different workers possess different skills.
examples.cn: 不同的工作者有不同的技能。

examples.en: Rose is a woman who possesses a rare intelligence.
examples.cn: 罗丝是一个拥有非凡智慧的女人。

examples.en: The police asked me if I possessed a gun.
examples.cn: 警察问我是否有枪。

examples.en: It is virtually impossible to predict the future accurately.
examples.cn: 精确预言未来的事实际上是办不到的。

examples.en: The economists predicted an increase in the rate of inflation.
examples.cn: 经济学家预言通货膨胀率将会增长。

examples.en: The earthquake had been predicted several months before.
examples.cn: 这次地震早在几个月以前就发布了预报。

examples.en: I would prefer to stay home rather than go out on such a rainy day.
examples.cn: 在这种雨天，我宁可待在家也不出门。

examples.en: All this gracious living is not for me；I prefer the simple life.
examples.cn: 这种优裕的生活对我不合适；我还是更喜欢简朴的生活。

examples.en: Which one do you prefer, an apple or an orange?
examples.cn: 你想要哪个，苹果还是橘子？

examples.en: Early experiments with military rockets prepared the ground for space travel.
examples.cn: 早年对军用火箭进行的实验为发展航天技术奠定了基础。

examples.en: He is preparing his speech for the meeting tomorrow.
examples.cn: 他正准备明天集会的演说。

examples.en: Prepare to alight,for we are almost there.
examples.cn: 我们马上就要到了

examples.en: It is highly important to preserve the environment.
examples.cn: 保护自然环境至关重要。

examples.en: It's the duty of the police to preserve the public order.
examples.cn: 维护公共秩序是警察的职责。

examples.en: You should preserve your papers for future use.
examples.cn: 你应当把你的文件保存起来以备将来之用。

examples.en: She pretends that she likes them so that she can get their help.
examples.cn: 她假装很喜欢他们，借以获得他们的帮助。

examples.en: The young actor pretended to be Hamlet.
examples.cn: 那个年轻演员扮演哈姆雷特。

examples.en: She closed her eyes and pretended to be asleep.
examples.cn: 她闭上眼睛,装作睡着了。

examples.en: Scientists are trying to find ways to prevent disease.
examples.cn: 科学家们正试图找到预防疾病的方法。

examples.en: It is the job of the police to prevent crime.
examples.cn: 防止犯罪是警察的职责。

examples.en: Nothing can prevent us from carrying out the plan.
examples.cn: 什么也无法阻挡我们去实施这个计划。

examples.en: We received sanction to proceed with our plans.
examples.cn: 我们获准继续进行我们的计划。

examples.en: Please go upstairs and proceed through the security check and immigration.
examples.cn: 请您到楼上继续进行安全检查和移民检查。

examples.en: Please proceed with your presentation.
examples.cn: 请开始你的简报。

definitions.meaning: 生产；引起；提出；制片；分娩

examples.en: This tree produces rubber.
examples.cn: 这些树生产橡胶。

examples.en: It is certain that we shall produce this kind of engine.
examples.cn: 毫无疑问,我们将生产这种发动机。

examples.en: The plain weave is comparatively inexpensive to produce.
examples.cn: 相对来说,平纹组织的生产成本较低。

definitions.meaning: 进步；发展；缓速前进；促进

examples.en: The student is showing rapid progress in his studies.
examples.cn: 这个学生学习上进步很快。

examples.en: Physics has made enormous progress in this century.
examples.cn: 本世纪物理学的发展突飞猛进。

examples.en: They made slow progress towards the mountaintop.
examples.cn: 他们向山顶缓慢地前进。

definitions.meaning: 促进；提升；升迁；发起；促销，推销

examples.en: They discussed how to promote cooperation between the two countries.
examples.cn: 他们讨论如何促进两国间的合作。

examples.en: He has been promoted to general manager.
examples.cn: 他已被提升为总经理。

examples.en: He failed to get promoted for lack of resolution.
examples.cn: 他因缺乏果断力而未能得到升迁。

definitions.meaning: 打算；计划；向 ... 提议；求婚；提名

examples.en: I propose an early start tomorrow morning.
examples.cn: 我打算明天早上早点出发。

examples.en: He proposed to buy and run a farm.
examples.cn: 他计划购买并经营一个农场。

examples.en: The committee proposed that new legislation should be drafted.
examples.cn: 委员会建议着手起草新法规。

examples.en: He raised his arm to protect his child from hurt.
examples.cn: 他伸出手去，保护他的孩子免受伤害。

examples.en: These gallant soldiers will protect our country.
examples.cn: 这些勇敢的士兵会保卫我们的国家的。

examples.en: These rare tigers are protected by special laws.
examples.cn: 这些珍贵的老虎受到专门法律的保护。

examples.en: There wasn't enough evidence to prove him guilty.
examples.cn: 没有充分的证据证明他有罪。

examples.en: He has proved his courage in the battle.
examples.cn: 他已在这场战斗中证明了自己的勇气。

examples.en: The students are asked to prove the purity of copper.
examples.cn: 要求学生们检验铜的纯度。

definitions.meaning: 供给；提供；准备；规定；抚养

examples.en: Sheep provide us with wool.
examples.cn: 羊供给我们羊毛。

examples.en: The hotel provides a reservation of tickets for its residents.
examples.cn: 这家旅馆为旅客提供订票服务。

examples.en: We have to provide for possible accidents.
examples.cn: 我们要为可能发生的意外作些准备。

examples.en: Her book was published last year.
examples.cn: 她的书去年出版了。

examples.en: He published this book with his pen-name .
examples.cn: 他以笔名出版了这本书。

examples.en: Oxford University Press will publish a new magazine.
examples.cn: 牛津大学出版社将发行新杂志。

examples.en: She purchased a number of shares in the company.
examples.cn: 她在公司里买了一些股票。

examples.en: Tickets must be purchased two weeks in advance.
examples.cn: 票必须提前两周买。

examples.en: The receipt is your proof of purchase.
examples.cn: 这张发票是你购物的凭据.

definitions.meaning: 追求；追捕；继续执行；从事

examples.en: Everyone has the freedom to pursue their dreams.
examples.cn: 每个人都有追求各自梦想的自由。

examples.en: The police are pursuing an escaped prisoner.
examples.cn: 警方正在追捕一名越狱的逃犯。

examples.en: Let's not pursue this argument.
examples.cn: 让我们别再继续这个争论了。

definitions.meaning: 使具备资格；描述；[语]修饰

examples.en: This test will qualify you to fly an aircraft.
examples.cn: 这次考试将使你取得驾驶飞机的资格。

examples.en: His knowledge and skills qualify him for the job.
examples.cn: 他的知识和技能使他有资格担任这项工作。

examples.en: Your passport qualifies you to receive free medical treatment.
examples.cn: 你所持的护照可使你享有免费医疗。

examples.en: She asked the reporter not to quote her remarks.
examples.cn: 她要求记者不要引述她的话。

examples.en: Please quote your price in terms of pound.
examples.cn: 请您报盘时用英镑报价。

examples.en: Can you quote me a recent instance?
examples.cn: 你能给我举一个最近的例子吗？

definitions.meaning: 升起；举起；饲养；提出；引起；筹集，募集

examples.en: The percentage of the pay raise equals the increase in prices.
examples.cn: 薪水的提高比率和物价的上升一致。

examples.en: He got a raise in monthly wages.
examples.cn: 他的月薪增加了。

examples.en: The first thing that we did when we conquered the town was to haul down the enemy's flag and raise our own.
examples.cn: 我们占领这座城市以后以后所做的第一件事就是降下城里敌人的旗帜，升起我们自己的旗帜。

examples.en: Iron reacts with water and air to produce rust.
examples.cn: 铁与水和空气起化学反应而生锈。

examples.en: She reacted to the insult by turning her back on him.
examples.cn: 她受辱之后就不再理睬他了。

examples.en: How did they react to your suggestion?
examples.cn: 他们对你的建议有什么反应？

examples.en: Neither John nor I am to receive the award.
examples.cn: 约翰和我谁都不会接到奖赏。

examples.en: I was on vacation last week and didn't receive your fax.
examples.cn: 上星期我正在度假，没收到你们的传真。

examples.en: He was received as an honoured visitor.
examples.cn: 他以贵宾的身分受到款待。

definitions.meaning: 承认；认出；意识到；表示感激；识别

examples.en: His thorough knowledge and competence were recognized.
examples.cn: 他的渊博的学识和工作能力得到了承认。

examples.en: I recognize your right to ask that question.
examples.cn: 我承认你有权提出这个问题。

examples.en: Can you recognize her from this picture?
examples.cn: 你能从这张照片中认出她吗？

definitions.meaning: 推荐；建议；劝告；使受欢迎；使可取

examples.en: Can you recommend me some new books on this subject?
examples.cn: 你能推荐一些有关这个学科的新书给我吗?

examples.en: I should recommend it as a useful reference book.
examples.cn: 我愿意推荐它作为一本有用的参考书。

examples.en: I recommend you to buy this dictionary and that tape.
examples.cn: 我建议你买这本字典和那盒磁带。

examples.en: He's now fully recovered from his stroke.
examples.cn: 他现已从中风病完全康复了。

examples.en: He is very ill and unlikely to recover.
examples.cn: 他病得非常厉害，不大可能恢复健康了。

examples.en: I nearly fell but managed to recover myself.
examples.cn: 我差一点倒下,但最后还是站稳了脚根。

definitions.meaning: 减少；缩小；使落魄；简化；还原

examples.en: The new government's prime task is to reduce the level of inflation.
examples.cn: 新政府的主要任务是减低通货膨胀的水平。

examples.en: We need to reduce our dependence on oil as a source of energy.
examples.cn: 在能源方面,我们需减少对石油的依赖。

examples.en: We must gradually reduce the wage gap.
examples.cn: 我们要逐步缩小工资差距。

definitions.meaning: 把 ... 提交；把 ... 归因；归类

examples.en: We referred the proposal to the board of directors.
examples.cn: 我们把这一建议提交董事会处理。

examples.en: You should refer this matter to the head office for a decision.
examples.cn: 你应当把这事提交总部去决定。

examples.en: He referred all his troubles to bad luck.
examples.cn: 他将他的一切麻烦都归因于运气不好。

definitions.meaning: 反映；反射；反省；归咎；显示

examples.en: Her sad looks reflected the thought passing through her mind.
examples.cn: 她忧戚的面容反映出她内心的思想。

examples.en: The results reflect the greatest credit upon all concerned.
examples.cn: 这些成绩带给所有有关人员最大的荣誉。

examples.en: The sunlight was reflected in the water.
examples.cn: 日光由水面反射出来。

examples.en: Our reform made an inexorable march of progress.
examples.cn: 我们的改革取得了势不可挡的进展。

examples.en: Many reforms must be made to the education system.
examples.cn: 教育体制要作许多改革。

examples.en: The reform and open policy has Brought us Chinese people a rich and colourful life.
examples.cn: 改革开放的政策给我们中国人民带来了富裕和多彩的生活。

examples.en: I refuse to answer that question.
examples.cn: 我不愿回答那个问题。

examples.en: We were refused permission to enter.
examples.cn: 我们被拒之门外。

examples.en: There is a refuse dump out of the town.
examples.cn: 镇外有个垃圾场。

definitions.meaning: 后悔；惋惜；为 ... 感到遗憾

examples.en: I now regret having made a promise that I would join in the scheme.
examples.cn: 我现在后悔答应参加该计划的事。

examples.en: We deeply regret that this big fire has taken away two young men's lives.
examples.cn: 这次大火夺走了两个年轻人的生命,我们为此感到深深的惋惜。

examples.en: We regret that we have to place the entire shipment at your disposal.
examples.cn: 很遗憾，我们只得将全部货品退回贵方自行处理。

examples.en: Specification could be regulated as buyer's request.
examples.cn: 指标可根据客户要求进行调整。

examples.en: Regretfully, we can't regulate the irregular liner on the gulf.
examples.cn: 遗憾的是我们不能调整海湾上不定期的班船。

examples.en: Your watch is always slow; it needs to be regulated.
examples.cn: 你的手表总是慢，需要校准一下。

examples.en: He rejected their offer of a job.
examples.cn: 他拒绝了他们给他的工作。

examples.en: After the transplant his body rejected the new heart.
examples.cn: 他的身体对新移植的心脏产生了排斥作用。

examples.en: If the application is unfounded, the people's court shall make an order to reject it.
examples.cn: 申请不成立的,裁定予以驳回。

definitions.meaning: 叙述；使有联系；有关联；涉及；符合；发生共鸣

examples.en: To what events did your remarks relate?
examples.cn: 你的话指的是什么事?

examples.en: It is difficult to relate cause and effect in this case.
examples.cn: 这个案件中的动机与结果很难联系起来。

examples.en: These two events were related to each other.
examples.cn: 这两个事件相互有联系。

definitions.meaning: 休息；放松；使 ... 放松；放宽

examples.en: I just want to sit down and relax.
examples.cn: 我只想坐下休息会。

examples.en: I felt my shoulders relax a little.
examples.cn: 我觉得我的肩膀放松了好多。

examples.en: His muscles relaxed.
examples.cn: 他的肌肉松弛了。

definitions.meaning: 释放；让与；准予发表；发射

examples.en: The prisoner was questioned before his release.
examples.cn: 囚犯被释放之前受到了审问。

examples.en: The puffball is ready to release its spores.
examples.cn: 尘菌已经要释放孢子了。

examples.en: The electrons in the upper band eventually release energy, thereby emitting photons.
examples.cn: 上层能带中的电子最后会发射光子释放能量。

examples.en: They have to rely on the river for their water.
examples.cn: 他们用水只好依靠这条河。

examples.en: A man should rely upon his own power.
examples.cn: 人类应该依靠自身的力量。

examples.en: You can't rely on his assistance.
examples.cn: 你不能指望他能帮助你。

examples.en: He removed the mud from his shoes.
examples.cn: 他去掉鞋上的泥。

examples.en: How can we remove the husk of the grains?
examples.cn: 我们怎样去掉谷物的外皮？

examples.en: Come and remove your wet coat.
examples.cn: 过来把你的湿上衣脱掉。

definitions.meaning: 提供；表现；使成为；宣布；翻译；回报；给予补偿；【计】渲染

examples.en: We are going to render them economic assistance.
examples.cn: 我们打算向他们提供经济援助。

examples.en: The power of the ocean was beautifully rendered in the poem.
examples.cn: 这首诗将大海的力量表现得非常完美。

examples.en: His back injury had rendered him unfit for work.
examples.cn: 他的背伤使他无法胜任这份工作。

examples.en: The trees renew their foliage every year.
examples.cn: 树木每年都重新长出叶子。

examples.en: I must renew the water in the fish-tank.
examples.cn: 我一定要给鱼箱重新注满水。

examples.en: It is impossible to renew one's youth.
examples.cn: 重新恢复青春是不可能的。

examples.en: The rent is due at the end of each quarter.
examples.cn: 缴纳租金以每季度末为期限。

examples.en: They let the house to me at a rent of 100 dollars a month.
examples.cn: 他们把房子租给我，每月租金一百美元。

examples.en: I rent a room from her.
examples.cn: 我向她租了一个房间。

definitions.meaning: 修理；修补；补救；维修工作；维修状态

examples.en: She turned the chair on its side to repair it.
examples.cn: 她把椅子翻转过来修理。

examples.en: I'll have my watch repaired; it doesn't work.
examples.cn: 我得修修表，它不走了。

examples.en: The overcoat is so old, it won't repair.
examples.cn: 这件大衣太旧了，不能修补了。

examples.en: A repeat of a television program is boring.
examples.cn: 电视节目的重播是很乏味的。

examples.en: Malcolm is forced to repeat crimes on himself.
examples.cn: 马尔康不得不反复声言自己有罪。

examples.en: Repeat this process repetitively, each time going farther and farther from the dog.
examples.cn: 反复这一过程，逐渐地加大你与狗之间的距离。

definitions.meaning: 取代；替换；放回原处；偿还

examples.en: Nothing can replace a mother's love.
examples.cn: 什么都无法取代母爱。

examples.en: We've replaced the old adding machine with a computer.
examples.cn: 我们用电脑取代了老式的加法计算器。

examples.en: The coach decided to replace player No. 8 with No. 3.
examples.cn: 教练决定让3号替换8号。

examples.en: What a sage reply you gave!
examples.cn: 多聪明的回答啊！

examples.en: He gave me no chance to reply to his question.
examples.cn: 他没有给我回答他问题的机会。

examples.en: I'm rather hazy about how to reply.
examples.cn: 我不清楚如何回答。

definitions.meaning: 报告；传闻；成绩单；爆炸声
报告；报导；叙述；举报；报到；对…负责

examples.en: He is reading a report of the state of the roads.
examples.cn: 他正在看一篇关于道路状况的报告。

examples.en: I have only reports to go on.
examples.cn: 我的依据只是谣传而已。

examples.en: My son got an excellent report last semester.
examples.cn: 我儿子上学期成绩出色。

definitions.meaning: 表现；表示；描绘；代表；象征；说明；阐明

examples.en: Monsters in dreams often represent fears.
examples.cn: 怪物在梦里经常表现为恐惧。

examples.en: Both represent the triumph of passion over reason.
examples.cn: 两者都表现出理智之外的激情。

examples.en: Dotted arrows represent flow of information.
examples.cn: 虚矢线表示信息流程。

examples.en: The director required that we should work all night.
examples.cn: 主任要求我们通宵工作。

examples.en: We must not propagate one method and require all localities to adopt it.
examples.cn: 我们在宣传上不要只讲一种办法，要求各地都照着去做。

examples.en: Please call if you require assistance.
examples.cn: 如果需要帮忙，请打电话。

examples.en: He dived from the bridge to rescue the drowning child.
examples.cn: 他从桥上跳入水中去抢救那溺水儿童。

examples.en: Had Jim not dived in to rescue him, the boy would have drowned.
examples.cn: 如果不是吉姆跳下水去救，那小孩早就淹死了。

examples.en: The government has rescued the firm from bankruptcy by giving them a grant.
examples.cn: 政府拨款给这家公司使其免于破产。

examples.en: The brothers resemble each other in taste.
examples.cn: 那对兄弟兴趣相似。

examples.en: She resembles her sister in appearance but not in character.
examples.cn: 她和她姐姐外貌相似，但性格不同。

examples.en: You resemble your mother very closely.
examples.cn: 你非常像你的母亲。

examples.en: Many young people could not resist the spiritual pollution.
examples.cn: 很多年轻人不能抵制精神污染。

examples.en: They are determined to resist invasion.
examples.cn: 他们决定抵抗入侵。

examples.en: The nobility usually resist social changes.
examples.cn: 贵族通常反对社会变革。

examples.en: Intensive efforts are being made to resolve the dispute.
examples.cn: 现正全力以赴来解决这场纠纷。

examples.en: He resolved that nothing should hold him back.
examples.cn: 他下决心不让任何事情阻挡他。

examples.en: We can resolve the problem into more elementary items.
examples.cn: 我们能够把这个问题分解成更基本的细目。

examples.en: The island is a favorite summer resort for tourists.
examples.cn: 这座岛是旅游者的避暑胜地。

examples.en: Its unique natural scenery makes it an ideal holiday resort.
examples.cn: 独具特色的自然景观,使这里成为度假休闲的理想胜地。

examples.en: A carriage was the only resort.
examples.cn: 乘马车是唯一的办法。

examples.en: In a move to restrict imports, the government raised custom duties.
examples.cn: 政府在限制进口的措施中提高了关税。

examples.en: Recent laws have tended to restrict the freedom of the press.
examples.cn: 新法例有限制新闻自由的趋势。

examples.en: I restrict myself to smoking two cigarettes a day.
examples.cn: 我限定自己每天只抽两支烟。

definitions.meaning: 结果；成果；答案；成绩；(足球比赛)赢

examples.en: These problems are the result of years of bad management.
examples.cn: 这些问题是由于多年管理不善而造成的。

examples.en: The presumable result is an election defeat.
examples.cn: 推测结果是竞选可能会失败。

examples.en: She looked with pride at the result of her work.
examples.cn: 她自豪地看着自己的工作成果.

examples.en: His speech could not retain the interest of his audience.
examples.cn: 他的讲话不能保持住听众的兴趣。

examples.en: I will retain my right.
examples.cn: 我将保留我的权力。

examples.en: Does it retain the key elements of the original story?
examples.cn: 它是否保留了原作的关键要素?

definitions.meaning: 革命；变革；重大改变；旋转

examples.en: Most countries have had revolutions aganist the government.
examples.cn: 大多数国家发生过反对政府的革命。

examples.en: The industrial revolution had taken place in England first.
examples.cn: 工业革命首先在英国发生。

examples.en: Those people go around preaching revolution.
examples.cn: 那些人到处宣扬革命。

examples.en: This is the only means of access to the building.
examples.cn: 这是进入这栋楼的唯一入口。

examples.en: The avalanche cut off the access to the mountain village.
examples.cn: 雪崩切断了进入山村的通道。

examples.en: The only access to that building is along the track.
examples.cn: 到那座大楼的唯一通道就是沿这条小路走。

examples.en: For a goalkeeper,it's a great advantage to have big hands.
examples.cn: 对于守门员来说,有一双大手是很大的优势。

examples.en: Rich has an advantage over you since he can speak German.
examples.cn: 理奇比你占优势，因为他会讲德语。

examples.en: It is an advantage if you know how to type.
examples.cn: 如果你会打字,对你将有利。

examples.en: To the well-organized mind, death is but the next great adventure.
examples.cn: 中文的意思是,对于一个理性极其成熟的人来说,死亡仅仅是下一个伟大冒险。

examples.en: No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't persuade his friends to give up the adventure.
examples.cn: 无论他怎么努力,都不能说服他的朋友们放弃冒险。

examples.en: He's sailed the seven seas in search of adventure.
examples.cn: 他闯荡七大洋去历险。

examples.en: A lot of people replied to our advertisement.
examples.cn: 有许多人对我们的广告作出了反应。

examples.en: They inserted an advertisement in the newspaper.
examples.cn: 他们在这家报纸上刊登一则广告。

examples.en: The wall was  covered with advertisements.
examples.cn: 墙上贴满了广告。

examples.en: I hope we can see eye to eye about the other terms of the agency then.
examples.cn: 我希望到那时候我们能在代理协议的其他条款上能取得一致意见。

examples.en: I got this job through an employment agency.
examples.cn: 我通过职业介绍所找到了这份工作。

examples.en: They resigned their child to an adoption agency.
examples.cn: 他们把自己的孩子交给了一家收养机构。

examples.en: This agenda will form the basis of our next meeting.
examples.cn: 本议程将成为下次会议的中心议题。

examples.en: Let's go on to the next item on the agenda.
examples.cn: 我们讨论议程表上的下一项吧。

examples.en: Let's thrash the matter over before putting it on the agenda.
examples.cn: 我们先把这件事仔细研究一下，再把它列入议事日程。

examples.en: A petrol gauge shows the amount of petrol left in a car.
examples.cn: 汽油表指示出汽车里所剩的汽油数量。

examples.en: He has a large amount of mail to answer every day.
examples.cn: 他每天有大量的信件要回复。

examples.en: Remember to tell the guest the amount of the bill.
examples.cn: 记得告诉客人帐单的总额。

examples.en: His analysis of the problem showed great perception.
examples.cn: 他对该问题的分析显示出敏锐的洞察力。

examples.en: We agreed with his acute analysis of the political situation.
examples.cn: 我们都同意他对政治形势的深刻分析。

examples.en: Close analysis of sales figures showed clear regional variations.
examples.cn: 对销售额的仔细分析显示出明显的地区差别。

examples.en: During the festival the investor investigated his ancestor.
examples.cn: 节日期间投资者调查了他的祖宗。

examples.en: They said their ancestor was a famous hunter and a crack hunter.
examples.cn: 他们说他们的祖宗是个有名的猎人，也是个神枪手。

examples.en: People who share an ancestor are called relatives.
examples.cn: 有同一个祖先的叫做亲戚。

definitions.meaning: 每年的；年度的；一年生的

examples.en: The firm has an annual turnover of $75 million.
examples.cn: 这家公司的年营业额为7500万美元。

examples.en: Now, again, his annual trip to Paris begins.
examples.cn: 现在,他一年一度的巴黎之行又开始了。

examples.en: The kind of plant is a hardy annual.
examples.cn: 这种植物是耐寒的一年生植物。

definitions.meaning: 面积；地区，地段；区域；领域

examples.en: The farm has an area of 100 square kilometers.
examples.cn: 这个农场占地100平方公里。

examples.en: The area of the office is 35 square meters.
examples.cn: 办公室的面积是35平方米。

examples.en: This area has not been covered by the communication net.
examples.cn: 这个地区还不在通讯网的覆盖之内。

definitions.meaning: 辩论；论点；论据；争论；理由；(函数)自变量

examples.en: She handled a difficult argument skilfully.
examples.cn: 她巧妙地应付了一场艰难的辩论。

examples.en: This argument, however, does not hold water.
examples.cn: 但是,这种观点是站不住脚的。

examples.en: This point is vital to my argument.
examples.cn: 这一点对我的论据极为重要。

definitions.meaning: 到达；达到；到达者；新生儿

examples.en: I am impatient for his arrival.
examples.cn: 我渴盼着他的到来。

examples.en: The secretary informed me of his arrival.
examples.cn: 秘书通知我他来了。

examples.en: Since her arrival at the company, she has re-organized several departments.
examples.cn: 自从她到这个公司,她已经重组了几个部门了。

definitions.meaning: 假定；设想；担任(职责等)；假装

examples.en: The project was predicated on the assumption that the economy was expanding.
examples.cn: 这一计划是以经济发展的设想为依据的。

examples.en: The theory is based on a series of wrong assumptions.
examples.cn: 这一理论是以一系列错误的设想为依据的。

examples.en: His assumption of power was welcomed by everyone.
examples.cn: 他的当权为大家所欢迎。

examples.en: The burning of fossil fuels results in the pollution of the atmosphere.
examples.cn: 矿物燃料的燃烧导致了大气污染。

examples.en: The atmosphere of the city is very much polluted.
examples.cn: 那个城市的空气受到严重污染。

examples.en: The atmosphere is very stuffy here and can we open a window?
examples.cn: 这里的空气很闷,咱们能打开一扇窗吗？

definitions.meaning: 注意；注意力；照料；留心；关怀；(口令)立正

examples.en: She soon becomes the centre of attention.
examples.cn: 她很快成为大家注意的人物。

examples.en: You should focus your attention on your work.
examples.cn: 你应该把注意力放到工作上。

examples.en: She gave her aging parents much attention.
examples.cn: 她悉心照料年迈的双亲。

examples.en: We must maintain a firm attitude.
examples.cn: 我们必须采取坚定的态度。

examples.en: She shows a very positive attitude to her work.
examples.cn: 她工作态度非常积极。

examples.en: He has a mellow attitude to life.
examples.cn: 他对生活有种成熟的看法。

definitions.meaning: 听众；观众；读者；倾听；拥护者；正式会见

examples.en: The audience was no less than five thousand.
examples.cn: 听众有五千人之多。

examples.en: Someone in the audience began to laugh.
examples.cn: 观众中有人开始笑起来。

examples.en: The concert drew a large audience.
examples.cn: 音乐会吸引了大量的观众。

definitions.meaning: 权力；官方；当局；职权；权威

examples.en: The government is the highest authority in the country.
examples.cn: 政府是国家的最高权力机构。

examples.en: Authorities say the fires do look suspicious.
examples.cn: 官方表示，火灾看起来确实很奇怪。

examples.en: Both the authorities and the media wondered whether insider dealing had been going on.
examples.cn: 官方跟媒体都在怀疑这里面是不是存在内幕交易。

examples.en: The average of 4,6 and 8 is 6.
examples.cn: 4,6,  8的平均数是6。

examples.en: Temperatures are below average for the time of year.
examples.cn: 温度低于此时的年平均温度。

examples.en: The average age of the boys in this class is fifteen.
examples.cn: 本班男生的平均年龄是十五岁。

examples.en: There is a general awareness that smoking is harmful.
examples.cn: 人们普遍认识到吸烟有害健康。

examples.en: This incident has sharpened public awareness of the economic crisis.
examples.cn: 这件事提高了公众对经济危机的认识。

examples.en: Youth glided past without our awareness.
examples.cn: 青春在我们不知不觉中逝去。

examples.en: The ice skater rammed into the barrier.
examples.cn: 溜冰者撞到护栏上了。

examples.en: Heavy duties on imports and exports are a barrier to international trade.
examples.cn: 进出口的高关税是国际贸易的障碍。

examples.en: The Sahara Desert is a natural barrier between north and central Africa.
examples.cn: 撒哈拉沙漠是北非与中非之间的天然屏障。

examples.en: It bolstered my belief.
examples.cn: 这增强了我的信念。

examples.en: He acted in accordance with his beliefs.
examples.cn: 他按照自己的信念行事。

examples.en: His belief of communism is immovable.
examples.cn: 他坚定不移地信仰共产主义。

examples.en: We crossed the state boundary at midnight.
examples.cn: 我们在午夜穿过了州界。

examples.en: They marked the boundaries of the football fields.
examples.cn: 他们画出了足球场地的边界。

examples.en: Scientists continue to push back the boundaries of knowledge.
examples.cn: 科学家不断地把知识领域的边缘向外扩展。

examples.en: Congress has approved the new educational budget.
examples.cn: 国会通过了新的教育预算。

examples.en: Our budget needs drastic revision.
examples.cn: 我们的预算需作重大修改。

examples.en: The government has budgeted 10000000 pounds for education spending.
examples.cn: 政府将10000000英镑编入教育预算。

definitions.meaning: 运动；战役；活动；竞选运动

examples.en: The campaign was a blockbuster.
examples.cn: 这次竞选运动声势浩大。

examples.en: They are planning a new campaign against corruption.
examples.cn: 他们正在策划一个新的反贪污运动。

examples.en: The campaign to seize the city was a failure.
examples.cn: 攻占这个城市的战役失败了。

definitions.meaning: 挑战；邀请比赛；盘问；质疑

examples.en: The crossing of this dangerous river was a challenge to most of us.
examples.cn: 对我们大多数人来说,横渡这条充满危险的大河确实是个挑战。

examples.en: He accepted his friend's challenge to swim across the river.
examples.cn: 他接受朋友提出的挑战，游过这条河。

examples.en: We accepted their challenge to a baseball game.
examples.cn: 我们接受了他们棒球邀请的挑战。

examples.en: That would be a daunting task with little chance of success.
examples.cn: 那样做的话任务过于艰巨,且成功的可能性微乎其微。

examples.en: Is there any chance of getting tickets for tonight's performance?
examples.cn: 有可能得到今晚演出的票吗?

examples.en: Please give me a chance to explain.
examples.cn: 请给我个机会让我解释一下。

examples.en: His perception of the change came in a flash.
examples.cn: 他在一瞬间察觉到了这一变化。

examples.en: The change in the weather has mucked up our sports timetable.
examples.cn: 天气的变化打乱了我们运动比赛的日程。

examples.en: This is a tremendous change unparalleled in the history of China and of the world.
examples.cn: 这是一个绝大的变化，这是自有世界历史和中国历史以来无可比拟的大变化。

definitions.meaning: 频道；海峡；方法；通道；（消息）渠道
引导；形成河道；集中（精力）

examples.en: This channel comes on the air every morning at 7 am.
examples.cn: 这个频道每天早晨7点钟开始播放。

examples.en: The ship went through the English Channel fast.
examples.cn: 那条船很快的通过了英吉利海峡。

examples.en: She was seeking a channel for her creative energies.
examples.cn: 她正在为她创造性的能量寻找方法。

examples.en: The wintry weather has caused chaos on the roads.
examples.cn: 因风雪交加,道路上混乱不堪。

examples.en: After the failure of the electricity supplies, the city was in chaos.
examples.cn: 电力供应中断,城市陷于混乱之中。

examples.en: Without rules, people would live in a state of chaos.
examples.cn: 若无规则,人们将在混乱状态中生活。

examples.en: Ambition is a characteristic of all successful businessmen.
examples.cn: 雄心勃勃是所有成功生意人的共同特点。

examples.en: Kindness is one of his characteristics.
examples.cn: 和善是他的特性之一。

examples.en: A characteristic of the camel is its ability to live for a long time without water.
examples.cn: 骆驼的特点是不喝水也能活很长时间。

definitions.meaning: 责任；电荷；指控；费用；照顾
要价；充电；向前冲，冲锋；记在账上

examples.en: As group leader, you should take charge.
examples.cn: 你身为组长, 应当负起责任来。

examples.en: He was arrested on a charge of armed robbery.
examples.cn: 他被指控犯武装抢劫罪而遭逮捕。

examples.en: Rub the leather and the rubber will produce the charge.
examples.cn: 摩擦皮毛和橡胶会产生电荷。

definitions.meaning: 慈善；宽厚；慈善机关(团体)；仁慈

examples.en: They did so under the mask of charity.
examples.cn: 他们是打着慈善的幌子这么做的。

examples.en: True charity doesn't consist in almsgiving.
examples.cn: 真正的慈善不在于施舍。

examples.en: She was always very generous in her charity.
examples.cn: 她行善时总是很慷慨。

definitions.meaning: 环境；详情；事件；(复数)境况

examples.en: He was forced by the circumstances to do this.
examples.cn: 他做此事是为环境所迫。

examples.en: The choice of technique is, therefore, a matter of preference, and in some cases circumstance.
examples.cn: 因此,技术的选择是偏好的问题,在某些情况下也与环境有关。

examples.en: I cannot recollect the exact circumstance.
examples.cn: 我总是想不起确实的情况。

examples.en: He is a Dane inasmuch as he was born in Denmark, but he became a British citizen at the age of 30.
examples.cn: 他按其出生在丹麦来说是丹麦人，但他在30岁时成了英国公民。

examples.en: She is a lawful citizen.
examples.cn: 她是个守法的公民。

examples.en: This accusation of bribery is a vile smear on an honorable citizen.
examples.cn: 这项有关贿赂的指控是对一个正直公民的无耻诽谤。

examples.en: Chinese civilization is one of the oldest in the world.
examples.cn: 中国文化是世界上最古老的文化之一。

examples.en: The civilization of mankind has taken thousands of years.
examples.cn: 人类经数千年才文明开化。

examples.en: In some ways, civilization does not seem to have progressed much in the last century.
examples.cn: 在某些方面，上个世纪文明似乎进展不大。

definitions.meaning: 等级；阶级；阶层；班级；课；[生]纲；<口>出色的风度

examples.cn: 我没把他看作是与维迪一个级别的。

examples.en: All of us are working class.
examples.cn: 我们都是工人阶级。

examples.en: They are the leading class in our country.

examples.en: Britain has a temperate climate.
examples.cn: 英国气候温和。

examples.en: She adapted herself quickly to the new climate.
examples.cn: 她很快就适应了这种新气候。

examples.en: The small city has the climate that is changeable in the extreme.
examples.cn: 这座小城有变化多端的气候。

examples.en: What a coincidence!
examples.cn: 真是太巧了！

examples.en: That was a really creepy coincidence.
examples.cn: 那样的巧合实在太离奇了。

examples.en: That's the most incredible coincidence I've ever heard of!
examples.cn: 那是我听说过的最难以置信的巧合！

definitions.meaning: 学院；大学；学校；枢机主教团；社团

examples.en: He is studying in the theological college.
examples.cn: 他在那所神学院学习。

examples.cn: 他在法学院读书。

examples.en: He had passed the entrance examination of the college.
examples.cn: 他已经通过了大学的入学考试。

examples.cn: 首先,你要离开你的习惯,离开你的舒适地带。

examples.cn: 人性化设计,更提升了操作舒适性。

examples.en: The comment is recorded in the event log.
examples.cn: 此注释将记录在事件日志中。

examples.en: He made no comments on our proposal.
examples.cn: 他对我们的建议没有作评论。

examples.en: Her strange behavior caused a good deal of comment.
examples.cn: 她的反常行为引起了不少闲话。

examples.en: We must promote commerce with neighbouring countries.
examples.cn: 我们必须促进与邻国的贸易。

examples.en: Our country has been trying to broaden its commerce with other nations.
examples.cn: 我国一直在努力扩大与其他国家的贸易往来。

examples.en: In USA, NewYork City is the chief seat of commerce.
examples.cn: 在美国,纽约是主要的商业中心。

definitions.meaning: 交流；通讯；传达；通信；沟通

examples.en: Most important of all, computers create wide communication around the world.
examples.cn: 最重要的是,计算机在世界范围内建立了广泛的交流。

examples.en: Being able to hold a conversation does not necessarily mean having effective communication.
examples.cn: 能够对话并不意味着在进行有效的交流。

examples.en: This area has not been covered by the communication net.
examples.cn: 这个地区还不在通讯网的覆盖之内。

definitions.meaning: 社区；社会；公众；共同体；团体；共享；共有；[生]群落

examples.en: Here is a local Jewish community.
examples.cn: 这是当地犹太人的一个社区。

examples.en: Everyone should invest some time in community service.
examples.cn: 每个人都应该花些时间在社区服务上。

examples.en: Community colleges have become popular and their enrollments have increased rapidly.
examples.cn: 社区大学日渐增多，报名人数迅速增长。

examples.en: Everyone in modern society faces keen competitions.
examples.cn: 现代社会的每个人都面临着激烈的竞争。

examples.en: To our satisfaction, he had got the first prize in the diving competition.
examples.cn: 我们满意的是,他在跳水比赛中获得了一等奖。

definitions.meaning: 抱怨；疾病；诉苦；控告；投诉

examples.en: You have no cause for complaint.
examples.cn: 你没有理由抱怨。

examples.en: You're always having complaints.
examples.cn: 你一直都有怨言。

examples.en: I have a complaint of the chest.
examples.cn: 我胸部不适。

definitions.meaning: 零部件；元件；组成部分；成分

examples.en: The factory supplies components for the car industry.
examples.cn: 该工厂向汽车业供应零部件。

examples.en: Each of the components is useful in its degree.
examples.cn: 每一个元件都各有程度不同的用处。

examples.en: The militia is a component of the state's armed forces.
examples.cn: 民兵是国家武装力量的组成部分。

examples.en: I can not understand such an abstract concept.
examples.cn: 我无法理解如此抽象的观念。

examples.en: He presented a new concept of the origins of the universe.
examples.cn: 他提出了一种宇宙起源的新概念。

examples.en: We had no concept that this tiny mistake would ruin the whole plan.
examples.cn: 我们完全没有想到这个小小的失误会毁掉整个计划。

definitions.meaning: 关心；关心的事；忧虑，担心

examples.en: Hardly a whisper of concern has been voiced.
examples.cn: 没有人表示过一点点的关心。

examples.en: Provision of shelter was their main concern for the disaster victims.
examples.cn: 为灾民提供避难处是他们最关切的事。

examples.en: I am not insensible of your concern.
examples.cn: 我不是没察觉到你的忧虑。

examples.en: I found the conclusion of her story very exciting.
examples.cn: 我觉得她那故事的结尾很激动人心。

examples.en: Some found the conclusion of the film Titanic very disappointing.
examples.cn: 有些人觉得电影《泰坦尼克号》的结尾是令人失望的.

examples.en: Your information is inaccurate and your conclusion is therefore wrong.
examples.cn: 你的信息不准确，所以你的结论是错误的。

definitions.meaning: 训练；决定；以 ... 为条件；护理（头发）

examples.en: Conditions in poor quarters were horrible.
examples.cn: 城里穷人居住区条件十分糟糕。

examples.en: I had halfway decided to accept their conditions at that time.
examples.cn: 当时我已差不多决定要接受他们的条件了。

examples.en: The terrorists will only release their hostage on certain condition.
examples.cn: 恐怖分子只有在某些条件下才释放人质。

definitions.meaning: 会议；讨论会；协商会；会谈

examples.en: He is in conference.
examples.cn: 他正在开会。

examples.en: An international conference will be held in Beijing next month.
examples.cn: 一个国际性的会议下月将在北京举行。

examples.en: There will be a banquet following the conference.
examples.cn: 会议过后将有一个宴会。

examples.en: The servant enjoyed his master's confidence.
examples.cn: 这仆人深得主人的信赖。

examples.en: We have full confidence that we shall succeed.
examples.cn: 我们完全有把握取得成功。

examples.en: The worst barrier to your success is not lack of money, but lack of confidence.
examples.cn: 你成功最大的障碍不是缺钱,而是缺乏信心。

examples.en: Both sides suffered heavy casualties in the border armed conflict.
examples.cn: 在这次边界武装冲突中双方都遭到了重大伤亡。

examples.en: He was wounded in the conflict.
examples.cn: 他在战斗中负伤。

examples.en: This is an irreconcilable conflict.
examples.cn: 这是一个不可调和的矛盾。

definitions.meaning: 惶惑；混淆；混乱；不确定状态

examples.cn: 他惶惑地凝视着这种奇怪的景象。

examples.en: This misprint led to great confusion.
examples.cn: 这个印刷错误造成很大的混淆。

examples.cn: 诸如 believe和 receive 这样的词在拼写上容易混淆。

examples.en: What is the connection between the two ideas?
examples.cn: 这两个概念之间有何联系？

examples.en: There is no connection between them.
examples.cn: 他们之间没有什么关系。

examples.en: Your connection with the press served out turn.
examples.cn: 你与新闻界的关系正适应了我们的需要。

examples.en: It terrified me to contemplate the consequence of your action.
examples.cn: 一想到你行动的后果,我就感到害怕。

examples.en: He studied hard, and in consequence he passed the exam.
examples.cn: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。

examples.en: Happiness is not a reward it is a consequence.
examples.cn: 幸福不是报偿，而是结果。

examples.cn: 请允许我重提我们刚才讨论过的问题，我想我们应该强调保存我们的自然资源。

examples.en: Conservation methods will also help meet their energy needs.
examples.cn: 能量保存方法也会有利于满足其能源需求。

examples.en: Most people have come to accept the need for conservation of natural resources.
examples.cn: 现在大多数人已认识到保护自然资源的必要。

definitions.meaning: 考虑；体贴；考虑因素；敬重；意见

examples.en: Please give the matter your careful consideration.
examples.cn: 此事请你仔细考虑。

examples.en: He showed no consideration for his wife.
examples.cn: 他不体贴他的妻子。

examples.en: Thank you for all your consideration and help.
examples.cn: 谢谢您的关心和帮助。

examples.cn: 中国正在经济建设方面大步前进。

examples.en: It is an object of simple construction.
examples.cn: 它是一个简单结构的物体。

examples.en: The cathedral is a fantastic modern construction.
examples.cn: 那个教堂是奇特的现代建筑。

examples.cn: 我终于在巴黎同她取得了联系。

examples.cn: 这篇演说需要放到20世纪60年代的英国这一背景之下来看待。

examples.cn: 他们已给合同定了期限。

examples.cn: 各个家庭通过婚姻或者婚约来建立有力的亲缘关系。

examples.cn: 我到便利商店买食品备用。

examples.cn: 这家旅馆既舒适又方便。

examples.cn: 我们的成功与其归功于您的帮忙，不如归功于我们的合作。

examples.cn: 我们在调查的过程中得到警方的大力协助。

examples.en: He is American to the core.

examples.cn: 我决心不惜任何代价达到目的。

examples.cn: 他在面对危险的时候表现出非凡的勇气。

examples.cn: 我觉得我没有勇气告诉他这个坏消息。

examples.cn: 你有胆量玩蹦极跳吗?

definitions.meaning: 课程；讲座；过程；路线；一道(菜)

examples.cn: 你听说过相关的报道吗?

examples.en: My next conclusion is more relevant.
examples.cn: 我的另一个结论更切题。

examples.en: I don't think he is a reliable man.
examples.cn: 我认为他不是一个可靠的人。

examples.en: She may be slow but at least she's reliable.
examples.cn: 她迟钝是迟钝，但无论如何她很可靠。

examples.en: A reliable car is worth its weight in gold.
examples.cn: 靠得住的汽车就是无价之宝。

definitions.meaning: 有责任的；负责的；责任重大的；可靠的

examples.en: Who's responsible for the terrible mess?
examples.cn: 谁应该对这种混乱负责？

examples.en: As a boy, i know, i was responsible to help her.
examples.cn: 作为个男生,我知道,我有责任帮助她。

examples.en: We all think of her as a responsible teacher.
examples.cn: 我们都认为她是一位很负责的教师。

examples.en: If you are not sure it is secure, do not debug it.
examples.cn: 如果您不能确定它是安全的,请不要调试它。

examples.en: His place in history is now secure.
examples.cn: 他在历史上的地位现在已经稳固了。

examples.en: A climber needs secure footholds.
examples.cn: 攀登的人脚踩的地方要很牢固。

definitions.meaning: 重要的；有意义的；意味深长的；显著的

examples.en: The question under discussion is significant.
examples.cn: 讨论中的问题是重要的。

examples.en: Economic conditions are significant in many ways.
examples.cn: 经济条件在许多方面都是很重要的。

examples.en: All of us want our lives to be significant.
examples.cn: 我们每个人都希望我们的人生是有意义的。

examples.en: The two buildings are similar on the whole.
examples.cn: 从整体来看，这两幢楼是相似的。

examples.en: I sympathize with you; I've had a similar unhappy experience myself.
examples.cn: 我很同情你，我自己也有过类似的不幸遭遇。

examples.en: He talked about it in a similar way.
examples.cn: 他对此事有相似的说法。

examples.en: How can I persuade you that I am sincere?
examples.cn: 怎样才能使你相信我是真心实意的呢?

examples.en: I will oblige any sincere request.
examples.cn: 我会答应任何诚意的请求。

examples.en: I think he is sincere and quite without affectation.
examples.cn: 我认为他为人诚挚，毫不做作。

examples.en: Our manager is very strict with us.
examples.cn: 我们的经理对我们要求很严格。

examples.en: There are strict controls on immigration into this country.
examples.cn: 移民到这个国家有严格的限制。

examples.en: Anything you tell us is in the strictest confidence.
examples.cn: 你告诉我们的都是绝密信息。

examples.en: The money I have saved is sufficient for buying a car.
examples.cn: 我所存的钱足以买一辆汽车。

examples.en: I doubt whether they really have sufficient manpower.
examples.cn: 我怀疑他们是否真有足够的人力。

examples.en: There is sufficient food for everybody.
examples.cn: 有足够的饭菜供大家吃。

definitions.meaning: 高傲的；上层的；上好的；出众的

examples.en: He always does what his superiors tell him.
examples.cn: 他惟上级之命是从。

examples.en: He has no superior as a Shakespearian actor.
examples.cn: 他演莎士比亚戏剧无出其右。

examples.en: He smiled a superior smile as he drove past in his expensive new car.
examples.cn: 他开着那辆豪华的新车驶过时，傲慢的微微一笑。

examples.en: He suffered a temporary loss of memory.
examples.cn: 他暂时丧失了记忆。

examples.en: My love for you is not a temporary madness.
examples.cn: 我对你的爱意,并不是暂时的疯狂。

examples.en: The two parties procured a temporary agreement.
examples.cn: 双方达成了临时协议。

definitions.meaning: 紧急的；急迫的；坚持要求的

examples.en: They've made an urgent request for international aid.
examples.cn: 他们紧急请求国际援助。

examples.en: I was prevented from going by urgent business.
examples.cn: 我因急事不能去。

examples.en: Jean spoke, her voice low and urgent.
examples.cn: 吉恩说话的时候声音压得很低,感觉很急迫。

definitions.meaning: 至关重要的；有活力的；生死攸关的

examples.en: The government saw the introduction of new technology as vital.
examples.cn: 政府认为引进新技术至关重要。

examples.en: She's a very vital sort of person.
examples.cn: 她是个精力旺盛的人。

examples.en: Confronted with such a vital problem of life and death, he looked as cool as a cucumber.
examples.cn: 面对着这样重大的生死问题,他的神态却异常冷静。

definitions.meaning: 生动的；鲜艳的；栩栩如生的

examples.en: This place conjures up vivid memories.
examples.cn: 这个地方使人回忆起许多生动的往事。

examples.en: My daughter is a child with vivid imagination.
examples.cn: 我女儿是一个想象力活跃的孩子。

examples.en: This girl gave a vivid description of the event.
examples.cn: 那女孩对这件事作了一番生动的描述。

examples.en: Additionally, the bus service will run on Sundays, every two hours.
examples.cn: 此外，公共汽车将于星期天运行服务，每两小时一班。

examples.en: Members receive six newsletters a year. Additionally, they have the use of a helpline.
examples.cn: 成员每年收到六份时事通讯，同时，他们还可以使用热线服务电话。

examples.en: Additionally, we shall make sure that foreign funds are more effectively utilized.
examples.cn: 此外，我们要确保更有效地利用外资。

examples.en: The plane will be taking off in approximately five minutes.
examples.cn: 飞机大约五分钟后就起飞。

examples.en: Approximately it has 400 pages when this book is completed.
examples.cn: 当这本书完成时大约有四百页。

examples.en: There were approximately fifty people there.
examples.cn: 那儿大约有五十个人。

examples.en: So we are basically, in agreement on that agenda.
examples.cn: 那么在日程问题上，我们基本上意见一致了。

examples.en: It's basically a slugfest with his units.
examples.cn: 基本上说这将会是一场激斗。

examples.en: There are many techniques but basically you use your heart and your solar plexus chakra for this.
examples.cn: 有许多技术，但是主要地为这个你们使用你们的心和你们的太阳丛脉轮。

examples.en: The scandal being exposed, he was removed from office consequently.
examples.cn: 他的丑闻被曝光了，他因此被调离了职位。

examples.en: The company went bankrupt and consequently he lost his job.
examples.cn: 公司破产,因此他失业了。

examples.en: My car broke down and consequently I was late.
examples.cn: 我的汽车坏了

examples.en: Our contracts are currently under review.
examples.cn: 我们的合同正在复查。

examples.en: Folk music is currently enjoying a renaissance.
examples.cn: 民间音乐现在又时兴起来了。

examples.en: The shares are currently being quoted at 54 pence a share.
examples.cn: 该股票现在的报价是每股54便士。

examples.en: Sincerity will definitely touch people, and what one puts out will definitely be repaid.
examples.cn: 真诚肯定会让人感动，付出一定会得到回报。

examples.en: All the students that work hard can definitely pass the exam.
examples.cn: 用功的学生必能通过考试。

examples.en: I definitely will give my consent to your plan.
examples.cn: 我当然同意您的计划。

examples.en: It was a long journey, but we eventually arrived.
examples.cn: 旅程很长，但我们最后还是到达了。

examples.en: He struggled with his assailants and eventually drove them off.
examples.cn: 他同攻击他的人进行搏斗，最后把他们赶走了。

examples.en: She eventually got back the book she had lent him.
examples.cn: 她终于收回了借给他的书。

examples.en: Buses run frequently from the city to the airport.
examples.cn: 公共汽车频繁地从城市驶往机场。

examples.en: The bicyclists must be hydrated frequently.
examples.cn: 自行车运动员必须频繁地喝水。

examples.en: His speech was frequently interrupted by stormy applause.
examples.cn: 他的演说不时被暴风雨般的掌声打断。

examples.en: Generally speaking, women live longer than men.
examples.cn: 一般而言，女性寿命较男性长。

examples.en: It is generally accepted that smoking is harmful to our health.
examples.cn: 吸烟有害健康，这是大家公认的。

examples.en: Generally, we go to the sea for our holidays.
examples.cn: 我们通常到海边度假。

examples.en: Controls in the city have gradually tightened.
examples.cn: 对这个城市的控制逐渐加强。

examples.en: Gradually the surrounding farmland turned residential.
examples.cn: 周围的农田渐渐变成了住宅区。

examples.en: The sea is gradually encroaching on the land.
examples.cn: 海水渐渐地侵蚀了陆地。

examples.en: Hardly anybody came.
examples.cn: 几乎没有人来。

examples.en: He could hardly refrain himself.
examples.cn: 他几乎不能自制。

examples.en: The desert air contains hardly any moisture.
examples.cn: 沙漠的空气几乎不含一点湿气。

examples.en: He began to look for another position immediately.
examples.cn: 他马上开始寻找另一个职位。

examples.en: Jason saw me and got off the horse immediately
examples.cn: 杰逊看到我, 立即从马上下来。

examples.en: All those who are immediately involved will be informed of the decision.
examples.cn: 这个决定将被通知给所有直接有关的人。

examples.en: Increasingly, farm land is yielding to property development.
examples.cn: 地产的发展逐渐占据了农田。

examples.en: New Zealand is an increasingly multicultural society.
examples.cn: 新西兰已经逐渐成为多元文化交融的国家。

examples.en: He grew increasingly to rely on her.
examples.cn: 他越来越依赖她了。

examples.en: They are not merely content to fill the stomach.
examples.cn: 他们不仅仅满足于填饱肚子。

examples.en: I accepted this job merely for the high salary.
examples.cn: 我仅仅是因为高薪才接受了这份工作。

examples.en: She is merely a child.
examples.cn: 她只不过是个孩子。

examples.en: When do you normally get in from work?
examples.cn: 你平时下班几点到家?

examples.en: I normally travel by public transport.
examples.cn: 我出门通常乘坐公共交通工具。

examples.en: Our forces are normally in various states of alert.
examples.cn: 我们的部队通常处于不同的战备状态。

examples.en: He was obviously drunk.
examples.cn: 他显然是醉了。

examples.en: She was obviously predestined to succeed.
examples.cn: 她显然注定了能成功。

examples.en: Obviously he is interested in music as well as (in) painting.
examples.cn: 显然他对音乐和绘画都有兴趣。

examples.en: He isn't particularly smart.
examples.cn: 他并不特别聪明。

examples.en: The instrumentation is particularly fine.
examples.cn: 这首器乐曲编得特别细致。

examples.en: The house itself is not particularly to my mind, but I like its environment.
examples.cn: 这房子本身并不特别合我的心意，但我喜欢它周围的环境。

examples.en: Relatively speaking, it's a cold day today.
examples.cn: 相对地说,今天是个寒冷的日子。

examples.en: These industries are relatively new.
examples.cn: 这些工业部门相对来说都是新型工业。

examples.en: The exam was relatively easy.
examples.cn: 这次考试比较容易。

definitions.meaning: 粗略地；大约；粗暴地；粗糙地；粗鲁地

examples.en: Roughly speaking, I would say that about100 people attended the exhibit.
examples.cn: 粗略地说来，我想大约有100人参观了展览。

examples.en: There were roughly 200 people there.
examples.cn: 那里大约有两百人。

examples.en: They all left at roughly the same time.
examples.cn: 他们都是大约同一时间离开的。

definitions.meaning: 意味深长地；意义深远地；重要地；较大地

examples.en: She paused significantly before she answered.
examples.cn: 她在回答之前意味深长地停顿了一下。

examples.en: Significantly New York is left out of this list.
examples.cn: 意味深长的是纽约这个城市的名字从名单中划掉了。

examples.en: Significantly, he did not deny that there might be an election.
examples.cn: 颇具意义的是,他没否认可能要进行选举。

definitions.meaning: (在数量方面)占；说明(原因等)； 对 ... 负责；导致，引起；击毙，杀死；报账

examples.en: Petrochemicals today account for one fourth of all the chemicals made, in ten years this amount is expected to double.
examples.cn: 石油化工产品现在已占所有化学制品的四分之一，十年后预计这个数目还要加倍。

examples.en: Students account for 50% of our customers.
examples.cn: 在我们的顾客中,学生占了一半。

examples.en: He has been asked to account for his conduct.
examples.cn: 他被要求解释他的行为。

examples.en: You will be accustomed to the climate soom.
examples.cn: 你很快就会习惯这里的气候。

examples.en: You must be accustomed to getting up early.
examples.cn: 你必须习惯早起。

examples.en: He made believe not to be aware of my presence.
examples.cn: 他假装不知道我在那里。

examples.en: You must be aware of the fact that he is destitute.
examples.cn: 你一定知道他非常贫穷这一情况。

examples.en: You are bound to feel tired after a long walk.
examples.cn: 长时间步行后你必然会感到疲劳。

examples.en: His comments were bound to attract criticism.
examples.cn: 他的评论必然会招致批评。

examples.en: He's bound to notice your mistake.
examples.cn: 他必定会觉察到你的错误。

examples.en: He was very concerned about her.
examples.cn: 他对她非常关心。

examples.en: There's nothing for you to be concerned about.
examples.cn: 没有什么需要你来关心的事。

examples.en: He is full of concern about his sick mother.
examples.cn: 他非常挂念他有病的母亲。

examples.en: George was determined to break off with those racists.
examples.cn: 乔治决心和那些种族主义者一刀两断。

examples.en: He was determined to hold on to this job whatever difficulties he might run into.
examples.cn: 他下定决心，不管碰到什么困难，都要坚持做这工作。

examples.en: The thief was determined to turn over a new leaf once he was released from prison.
examples.cn: 那盗贼下决心，一旦获释便重新做人。

definitions.meaning: 处于 ... 的作用下； 曝光于； 接触； 面临

examples.en: They had to be exposed to the enemy's gunfire.
examples.cn: 他们不得不冒着敌人的炮火。

examples.en: This plant can't be exposed to strong sunshine.
examples.cn: 这种植物不能暴露在强光下。

examples.en: The papers were inaccessible to the public.
examples.cn: 这些文件公众无法接触。

examples.en: They were involved in a long legal wrangle over payment.
examples.cn: 他们在付款问题上陷入长期纠纷。

examples.cn: 当他们问起是否有人会讲西班牙语时，玛丽碰我的手臂但我不愿意卷入这场争论之中。

examples.cn: 你收音机的音量必须控制在我们大家都以忍受的范围内。

examples.en: Linda was occupied with the work of redecorating her house.
examples.cn: 琳达忙于重新装修她的房子。

examples.en: The shipping company will be liable for damage.
examples.cn: 运输公司将对损坏负责。

examples.en: She is my child, and I am responsible for her.
examples.cn: 她是我的孩子，我对她负责。

examples.en: This game will be similar to Starcraft in a few ways.
examples.cn: 这个游戏一些地方会与相星相似。

examples.en: The connection string configuration will be similar to the following example.
examples.cn: 连接字符串的配置与下面的示例类似。

examples.cn: 自由放任政策导致经济活动的增加，但也促进了进口的增长。

examples.en: Does smoking contribute to lung cancer?
examples.cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌吗?

examples.en: Honesty and hard work contribute to success and happiness.
examples.cn: 诚实加苦干有助于成功和幸福。

examples.cn: 他毕生致力于科学事业。

examples.en: I devote myself heart and soul to the arduous task.
examples.cn: 我全心全意地致力于这项艰巨的任务。

examples.en: I will dedicate myself to science in the future.
examples.cn: 我将来一定要投身于科学事业。

examples.en: Students must have access to a good library.
examples.cn: 学生要有使用好图书馆的便利条件。

examples.en: She needs to have access to our files.
examples.cn: 她需要用我们的文件.

examples.en: People have access to higher education.
examples.cn: 大多数人能接受高等教育。

examples.en: In term of money, he's quite rich, but not in term of happiness.
examples.cn: 就钱来说他很富有，但就幸福来说就不然了。

examples.en: It was a bad year for films, in terms of both quantity and quality.
examples.cn: 今年的电影无论从数量上还是质量上都说不上好。

examples.en: Think of it in terms of an investment.
examples.cn: 从投资的角度来考虑那件事。

examples.en: The weather takes a hand in most of our plans.
examples.cn: 天气对我们的大多数计划都有影响。

examples.en: He has a tremendous hold over his younger brother.
examples.cn: 他对他弟弟很有影响。

examples.en: He called my attention to some new evidence.
examples.cn: 他要我注意一些新的证据。

examples.en: The problem presented itself for their attention.
examples.cn: 那问题引起了他们的注意。

examples.en: Pay more attention to the voice of youth.
examples.cn: 多留意年轻人的意见。

examples.cn: 他被邀请在这个电视剧里扮演一个角色。

examples.en: A famous actress is to play in our next production.
examples.cn: 一位著名女演员将在我们下一个剧本中扮演角色。

definitions.meaning: 涉及；指的是；提及；参考；适用于

examples.cn: 这条规则只涉及一些特殊的情况。

examples.cn: 当我那么说时,我并不是指她。

examples.en: Don't refer to this matter again, please.
examples.cn: 请不要再提这件事了。

examples.en: Don't rely on him to do anything he's just a talker.
examples.cn: 什么事都不要依靠他－－他光会说空话。

examples.en: Now that you are grown up, you should not rely on your parents.
examples.cn: 既然你长大了，就不应该依靠你的父母。

examples.en: They have to rely on the river for their water.
examples.cn: 他们用水只好依靠这条河。

examples.en: You should take advantage of it.
examples.cn: 你应该好好利用这个机会。

examples.cn: 在她喝醉时，他诱奸了她。

examples.en: Men take advantage of women when kissing.
examples.cn: 男人在接吻时占女人的便宜。

examples.cn: 一个人应该跟上时代的步伐。

examples.en: I was put to it to keep up with his pace.
examples.cn: 我跟上他是不容易的。

examples.en: Can't you break away from old habits?
examples.cn: 你不能戒除旧习惯吗?

examples.en: He's broken away from his family.
examples.cn: 他与家庭断绝了关系。

examples.cn: 吉姆离开他的朋友时，说道：“我得回去做功课了。”

examples.cn: 我们必须把注意力集中在效率上。

examples.en: They zeroed in on the suspicious man.
examples.cn: 他们的注意力集中在那个可疑分子身上。

examples.cn: 我们没有篇幅来讨论这种细微末节。

examples.en: I have a huge pile of letters to deal with.
examples.cn: 我有一大堆信件要处理。

examples.cn: 首先让我们来处理最紧要的问题。

examples.cn: 什么事妨碍你取得进步？

examples.cn: 什么也不能阻挡我们取得进步。

examples.cn: 政府采取措施稳定物价。

examples.cn: 我们应当采取措施制止战争。
